rows.description: A toddler runs away with a grin and looks back to be chased, inviting play. The look back is the invitation, so adults who join in build connection and turn-taking.
graph_context: this subtopic also appears at ages: 4–6, 7–12, 13–17, 18–22, 23–26

rows.description: A toddler screams, clings or arches away when overwhelmed or frightened. Distress needs calm closeness, since scolding raises arousal, and reading the trigger helps prevent it.
graph_context: this subtopic also appears at ages: 4–6, 7–12, 13–17, 18–22, 23–26
related mind states: fear, calm, overwhelm

rows.description: A toddler cries sharply, holds a body part or refuses to move when hurt. Toddlers cannot say where it hurts, so adults watch for pointing, guarding, fever and changes in eating or sleeping.
graph_context: this subtopic also appears at ages: 4–6, 7–12, 13–17, 18–22, 23–26
related mind states: hurt

rows.description: A toddler goes quiet, droops or whimpers when a caregiver leaves or a toy breaks. Sadness may look like tiredness, so comfort and a simple name for the feeling help.
graph_context: this subtopic also appears at ages: 4–6, 7–12, 13–17, 18–22, 23–26
related mind states: sadness, tiredness

rows.description: A toddler cries loudly with tears for hunger, pain, tiredness, frustration or fear. Crying is the main signal at this age, so caregivers check needs and offer soothing before reasoning.
graph_context: this subtopic also appears at ages: 4–6, 7–12, 13–17, 18–22, 23–26
related mind states: sadness, anger, fear, tiredness

rows.description: A toddler stamps, hits or throws things when blocked or frustrated. Anger at this age is big and physical, and calm limits with a name for the feeling help more than punishment.
graph_context: this subtopic also appears at ages: 4–6, 7–12, 13–17, 18–22, 23–26
related mind states: anger, calm

rows.description: A toddler freezes, clings or cries at a loud noise, stranger or dog. Fear is a survival signal, so comfort and gradual exposure work better than forcing or mocking.
graph_context: this subtopic also appears at ages: 4–6, 7–12, 13–17, 18–22, 23–26
related mind states: anger, fear

rows.description: A toddler hides behind a parent, looks away or goes quiet with strangers. Shyness is a temperament trait and improves with gentle warm-up time, not pushing.
graph_context: this subtopic also appears at ages: 4–6, 7–12, 13–17, 18–22, 23–26
related mind states: anger, shyness

rows.description: A toddler reaches, pokes, opens and points at everything, seeking to know. Curiosity is safe when the environment is safe, and naming things feeds language.
graph_context: this subtopic also appears at ages: 4–6, 7–12, 13–17, 18–22, 23–26
related mind states: curiosity, trust

rows.description: A toddler stares, leans in and goes still at a new sound or picture. Focused looking shows interest, and staring away can mean too much stimulation.
graph_context: this subtopic also appears at ages: 4–6, 7–12, 13–17, 18–22, 23–26
related mind states: interest
